description: Switches a NeuroVue window between Express, which gives the window to the viewer, and the dataset view, which adds the dataset pane of thumbnails and the filter sidebar beside it.

mode.description: "express" for the viewer alone, or "dataset" for the viewer with the dataset pane and filters.

neuroflow/mcp.name: set_window_mode
neuroflow/mcp.title: Switch between Express and the dataset view

useWhen: Give the viewer the whole window once you have picked a volume, before showing or screenshotting it.
Show the person the dataset's volumes and filters.

avoidWhen.when: You are about to filter or zoom the dataset pane; filter_dataset and zoom_dataset switch to the dataset view themselves.

effects: Changes the window's layout only: the dataset, the filter and the viewer's layers stay as they are.
The person's own choice of mode, remembered between launches, is left alone.
